messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty - P1 alert for tenant 'stellara' in dedicated-vpc-us-west. Tail latency >= 4s, 95th token latency spiking. Paging oncall.
rob_oncall: On it. Starting triage. Can someone post recent queue depth and max_batch_tokens for that tenant?
kevin_ml: Queue depth jumped to 120, average batch size ~2 tokens. Current tenant config: `max_batch_tokens: 1024`, scheduler: `adaptive`.
maria_sre: Hmm that small batch size + high queue depth explains tail latency. Likely not batching enough due to request shape.
infra_ops: We can try a temporary knob bump for that tenant to reduce scheduling overhead. Suggest `max_batch_tokens: 4096` and enable `burst_coalesce: true` for a 10m window.
rob_oncall: Good, what's the quick command to apply? I can push a live change via control-plane.
kevin_ml: Use the control API:
```bash
curl -X POST https://control.redwood.internal/tenants/stellara/config \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{"scheduler": {"max_batch_tokens": 4096, "burst_coalesce": true, "coalesce_window_ms": 50}}'
```
rob_oncall: Applying now (will keep change gated to tenant only). Will monitor 95/99 token latencies and cost meter.
deploy-bot: change-request:deploy started by rob_oncall for tenant stellara (change-id: ch-20260317-01)
stellara-sre: Thank you — customer seeing timeouts on long prompts, appreciate quick action.
rob_oncall: Change applied. Metrics coming in: queue depth down to 22, avg batch size 10 tokens, 95p latency dropped from 4.2s -> 0.9s within 45s.
maria_sre: Nice. Watch for CPU/GPU utilization bump and model throughput; we might need to cap concurrency if GPU pressure rises.
infra_ops: Noted. We'll watch node mem and gpu_util. If any node crosses 90% util, we'll temporarily route new requests to fallback variant.
eve_oncall: Taking handoff in 30m. Summary: temporary increase max_batch_tokens -> 4096 + burst_coalesce true; resolved tail latency, monitor for GPU pressure and cost. Full logs and change-id ch-20260317-01.
rob_oncall: FYI — rollback plan: revert `max_batch_tokens` to 1024 if GPU mem > 92% for >2m or if quality regressions reported.
stellara-sre: No quality regressions reported so far. We'll update if customers see anything.
kevin_ml: Also adding a short eval on a sample prompt set to ensure output stability under larger batches.
maria_sre: +1 on eval. I pushed a canary: `eval/stellara/20260317` running now.
eve_oncall: Handing off to @eve_oncall — will keep an eye for 2h then mark resolved if stable :thumbsup: 
rob_oncall: Thanks all. Filing post-incident note and will add knob history to tenant's config audit.
